pre_reflection.text:
[Pre-reflection] The strategy's reliance on multiple indicators creates potential for overfitting and false signals, especially during choppy markets. The ADX filter may lag trend changes, causing missed entries or premature exits. Bollinger Band breakouts can generate frequent whipsaws in ranging conditions, even with RSI and ADX filters.
[Backup plan] If results are poor, switch to a simpler momentum+filter approach using only RSI > 50 and ADX > 25 with fixed stop-loss. If Sharpe is low, optimize RSI period (e.g., 14→9) and tighten ADX threshold (e.g., 25→30). As alternative, try a dual-threshold breakout (upper+lower bands) with volume confirmation to reduce false signals.

iterations.hypothesis: Combining momentum (ROC) with trend strength (ADX) and volatility (ATR) creates a robust filter that avoids false signals during weak trends while capturing strong momentum moves, reducing the high drawdown and poor win rate of the previous strategy
